items.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract) | TRM Labs Remote Job
items.summary: TRM Labs is seeking a contract Recruiting Coordinator to support talent acquisition for its AI-powered intelligence platforms. This remote, worldwide role involves coordinating with candidates and hiring managers to build a safer world through technology. The position is ideal for professionals in Pakistan, India, or Europe seeking experience in the cybersecurity and AI sectors.

eligibility: Proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR coordination.
Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Familiarity with tech-sector hiring processes and candidate relationship management.
benefits: Fully remote, worldwide contract position with flexible working hours.
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cybersecurity technologies.

Submit your application via the official TRM Labs careers portal.

faqs.a: This is a contract-based role, not a full-time permanent employee position.
